_doc: Street furniture and crosswalks: the one owner of where every lamp, signal post, hydrant, bin, bench and street tree stands and where the crosswalk and stop line lie (native/src/sim/roads/street_furniture.cpp). The walkers keep off each piece's footprint; the render draws, lights and wires them from these places (how they look is data/render/streets.json). Lamps: first_m past the mouth, then every step_m, none within end_clear_m of the far mouth; the pole inset_m from the outer edge of the right sidewalk (else the left), the head reach_m toward the carriageway; a second row on the left sidewalk when the median is at least median_min_m wide. The night light pools follow the same stations.

furniture._doc: Roadcraft jobs/props.ts automatic furniture (m from the mouth or the sidewalk edges). Signal posts: signal_back_m past the crosswalk (crossing zebra_to_m), at most signal_max_share of the segment, signal_in_m from the kerb (Roadcraft 4.0: crosswalk + 2 m, kerb + 0.9 m). A hydrant, bin, bench or tree that would leave a walker no way past the pieces beside it is not placed (lamps and signal posts always are).

crossing._doc: Where a crosswalk lies at a junction mouth, metres from the mouth (the arm's setback): the painted zebra (walkers cross its middle line and keep to its right half), the stop line, how far behind that line vehicles stop (stop_clear_m) and how far past the zebra a leaving vehicle's rear has cleared it (zebra_clear_m).

footprints._doc: Ground each kind covers at walking height, [x_m, z_m] in its own frame (x along the sidewalk and z toward the road for the kerbside pieces; a signal post's z faces the arriving traffic): the pole, trunk or body; arms, heads and crowns are overhead.
